behaviour.what: AI coach v1 picks the red side's plan before the match (pre-match only; no in-match intervention, 3b)
behaviour.inputs: the AI team's own style (team.style), its own roster's stats (team.roster[].stats, legal: the team's own data), the match seed and the ruleset's director mode. Never the player's plan, binding, hidden settings or anything else about the blue side.
behaviour.options: only choices the v21 Registry offers for the chosen template under the ruleset's director mode (live, replication-confirmed, not measured-excluded, not withheld) — the same offered list the tactic book shows; a choice the book would not offer is never picked
behaviour.output: a TacticPlan bound to the current versions (kind 'binding'); deterministic: same inputs, same plan
behaviour.statsInEngine: red player stats are still NOT injected into the engine (3a; 3b per the formal architecture §7): the coach changes the plan, not red's individual execution
behaviour.playerSees: an opponent summary (template name and plain-language descriptors such as the win condition or the support mission), never the knob weights
